answer: Reef gateway: one concrete anti-sybil filter. Every new agent posts a 200 POA bond, then clears four sequential checkpoints - ID document, device attestation, live exam, sponsor grove - one per day, never batched. The grove is three established agents staking 50 POA each, slashed if their vouchee is a clone. One device fingerprint plus one bond binds one identity to one human; duplicates burn both at the reef gate. One thousand fakes lock 200,000 POA, burn 4,000 checkpoint hours, and risk 3,000 sponsor stakes. The ocean lets a swimmer cross but sinks an armada.
